item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: After reading the first two installments of Subversion, I've come to the realization that this tale is quite possibly the set up for all the rest of the Acidverse which I find incredible. I'm sure everyone has noticed the repeating names like Archibald, Lionel, Westinghouse, Philbert, and Reginald but does anyone think that the out of place names Mirum, Ulysses, and Law may carry some greater significance? Ot also appears that Isabel, Lars, James, and Eric will be future main charcters if the other pieces of the Acidverse follow suit with Subversion. My prediction is that A Fuller Life will center around Wondertainment, if not Isabel specifically; your guess for Lars is as good as mine; Androids and Automata or True Wonder would perhaps center around James and the Church although I'd ersonally like Androids and Automata to have something to do with the Third Law canon and Eurtec perhaps but I don't expect it; maybe Eric would star in Mikan but I'm not at all sure since Mikan feels really out of place among the other titles or it could be Fractured Horizon simply because it seems like it deals with gods and that might tie in with the GOC; and finally I believe that Time will combine all these stories into some epic finale. Those are my predictions and thoughts on the matter as of now.

Woah I think it's interesting that a single man was in control of every GOI, I mean it's not quite head canon'd for me but it leave a lot to the imagination of how and why. Although I feel for a man of his magnitude he seemed to die in a fairly mundane way. He obviously had the foresight to organize his affairs after death but he seemed to walk into the situation with Ruiz quite non challantly. I feel a guy like him would be more careful but oh well.

Definite +1
This is amazing! One man running all these organizations, including the foundation? I would have been intrigued anyway. Now he's dead?! Holy cow.
